# RETROSPECTIVE / POST-MORTEM — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Output file location:** `docs/pm/RETROSPECTIVE.md`.
> **Different from sprint retro:** sprint retro (in `DEVELOPMENT_KANBAN_TEMPLATE.md`) evaluates one
> sprint. This file evaluates the entire project, once at the end — patterns that only become visible
> when viewed across sprints.
> **Formality scale:** solo = honest self-review journal; team = structured retro session;
> enterprise = + anonymous 360 review + steering committee review.

---

## Session format (choose one, or combine)

| Format | Suited for | How it works |
|---|---|---|
| Start / Stop / Continue | Small team, quick | Three columns, 15 min individual brainstorm first then share |
| 4Ls (Liked / Learned / Lacked / Longed for) | Teams needing more nuance than Stop/Start | Same, four columns |
| Self-review journal | Solo developer | Answer the questions in §Solo below, write, do not edit to look polished |
| 360 anonymous | Team >5 people, culture not yet psychological-safe | Anonymous survey first, results clustered, then discussed together |

> **Why anonymous for large teams:** people rarely criticize decisions of superiors or senior
> colleagues openly when their name is recorded, especially when working together for the first time.
> Anonymity is not to avoid accountability — it is to get honest input
> before the same problems repeat in the next project.

---

## For Solo Developer

Answer honestly, write as-is — this file is for yourself in the next project, not
to look good:

1. What took significantly more time than expected? Why?
2. Which technical decision would you make differently if you could redo it?
3. Which parts did you skip testing because you were in a hurry, and did that cause problems later?
4. When did you feel most burned out/exhausted in this project — could it have been avoided with
   different planning, or was it inherent to the scope?
5. One thing you learned that you will immediately apply in the next project.

---

## For Teams

### What went well (Continue / Liked)

| Item | Why this is important to keep |
|---|---|
| {…} | {…} |

### What did not go well (Stop / Lacked)

| Item | Impact | Root cause (not symptom) |
|---|---|---|
| {…} | {…} | {…} |

### What to try differently (Start / Longed for)

| Item | Who is responsible for trying this in the next project |
|---|---|
| {…} | {…} |

> **Important rule:** "root cause" is not "developer was not careful enough" or "communication was lacking".
> Those are symptoms. Ask "why" three times. Example: developer was not careful → why? → because AC
> was not clear → why? → because requirement gathering was only 1 session without written documentation
> → that is the root cause, and that is what can be fixed in the next project (see QR1-QR8 in
> `REQUIREMENT_GATHERING_GUIDE.md`).

---

## 360 Review (team >5 people, optional for smaller teams)

Collect via anonymous survey before the session, with questions like:

```
- What did [role X] do well that helped this project?
- What is one thing [role X] could have done differently?
- (for PM/lead) Did you feel heard enough when raising concerns?
```

Results are clustered by theme (not by person) before discussion — prevents the session from
turning into one-by-one personal evaluations.

**Theme summary from 360 review:**
| Theme | Frequency mentioned | Follow-up action |
|---|---|---|
| {…} | {…} | {…} |

## Comparison with Previous Sprint Retrospectives

If there were sprint retros in `DEVELOPMENT_KANBAN_TEMPLATE.md` each sprint, check: did the
same problem appear repeatedly across sprints without ever being truly fixed?

| Recurring problem | Appeared in sprint | Why it was never fixed | Plan this time |
|---|---|---|---|
| {…} | {…} | {…} | {…} |

> A problem that appears in sprint retro 1, 3, and 5 without changing is not a sprint problem — it
> is a structural problem. This file is the right place to finally write it down explicitly
> and make a concrete plan.

## Follow-up Actions

A retrospective without follow-up actions is a venting session, not an improvement process. Every item in
"Start / Longed for" must have a row here:

| Action | PIC | Target | How to verify success |
|---|---|---|---|
| {…} | {…} | {Next project / first sprint of next project} | {…} |
